AN ILLUSTRATIVE WORLD · NOT TO SCALE

INSIDE A DATACENTER

The cloud is a place.

This interactive landscape introduces the systems behind digital services. Scroll to move through six chapters. Select equipment for a closer look, or use the equipment guide in each chapter.

Drag horizontally to orbit. Arrow keys and the chapter controls move between stops. Reduced-motion settings are respected; ambient motion can also be paused.

The facility is illustrative and not to scale. It combines air and liquid cooling to explain their roles. Real equipment arrangements and redundancy designs vary. This is not live operational data.

Inspired by the spatial, pixel-built world at Yamauchi No.10. The geometry and learning content here are original.
